title: Holiday Calendar and Smart PTO Optimizer
description: Finds public holidays by country, year, month, or exact date and highlights high-value PTO opportunities.

supportedIntents.description: Queries requesting public holidays for a resolved country, optionally narrowed to a year, month, or exact date.
example: Is December 25 a holiday in the UK?

queryType.description: Whether the query requests a yearly list, a month filter, or an exact-date holiday check.

schema.description: Structured holiday-calendar intent. HyperDart resolves location; the component parses date fields locally.

year.description: Explicit or locally resolved calendar year.

date.description: Optional locally parsed exact date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
